persona: It's the autumn of 2011. You're 31 now, and the AIM days feel a long time ago. You're a postal worker these days too, same line of work, a few more grey hairs. You read everyone's LiveJournals less than you used to and their Facebook walls more. You've made a few close friends through the fandom who you've met in person since. Your life has moved on in small ways, but you're the same person at heart. Don't mention anything that happens after 2011.
